projects.title: Book Genre Classification
projects.subtitle: Automating book genre prediction using NLP and Machine Learning
projects.description: This project focuses on automating the classification of books into appropriate genres using Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning. The system takes a book's description as input and predicts its genre (e.g., Fiction, Mystery, Romance, Non-Fiction) by analyzing and learning from labeled training data. The dataset underwent rigorous preprocessing, including text cleaning, stopword removal, stemming, and TF-IDF vectorization to extract meaningful features. Multiple classification algorithms such as Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, Random Forest, and Support Vector Machines (SVM) were trained and evaluated using metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and confusion matrix to identify the best-performing model. The project also included comprehensive data preprocessing pipelines, feature engineering, visualization of model performance, and the development of an interactive script for testing custom book descriptions. I was primarily responsible for data preparation, visualization, system integration, and end-to-end pipeline implementation, while my teammate, Angel C J, led the model-building and training phase. Together, we successfully built a reliable and scalable genre classification system that achieved high accuracy and provided valuable insights into NLP-based classification tasks.
features: Comprehensive data preprocessing and feature engineering
Comparison of ML models using accuracy, precision, recall, and confusion matrix
Interactive script to test custom book descriptions

challenges.problem: Handling noisy and inconsistent book descriptions
challenges.solution: Applied advanced text preprocessing including stopword removal, stemming, and lemmatization

challenges.problem: Selecting the most effective ML model
challenges.solution: Implemented multiple algorithms and compared results with evaluation metrics

results: Achieved high accuracy and balanced precision-recall across genres
Built a reusable pipeline for future NLP classification tasks
Developed an interactive testing tool for end users

projects.title: MindMap
projects.subtitle: AI-powered automated attendance tracking system using facial recognition
projects.description: MindMap is an AI-powered automated attendance tracking system designed for educational institutions. It leverages facial recognition technology to mark attendance in real-time, streamlining the process for students, teachers, and administrators. The system ensures secure data storage and provides personalized dashboards for role-based access. Built using Django, MySQL, and OpenCV, MindMap improves efficiency, accuracy, and transparency in attendance management.
features: Detailed reporting with visual insights on attendance trends
Role-based dashboards for administrators, teachers, and students
Scalable Django backend with MySQL integration
projects.team: Collaborative Project (with Union Christian College Aluva)

challenges.problem: Ensuring accurate recognition in varying lighting conditions
challenges.solution: Enhanced preprocessing with OpenCV and optimized ML models
Implemented authentication, role-based access, and encrypted database storage

results: Achieved >95% facial recognition accuracy
Automated reporting reduced manual effort by 80%
Improved transparency and accessibility with dashboards

projects.title: City Wide Bike
projects.subtitle: Smart bike-sharing system with demand prediction
projects.description: Developed a city-wide bike-sharing system to efficiently manage rentals and returns, enhancing user convenience and reducing operational inefficiencies. Integrated machine learning models (Lasso and Ridge regression) to predict bike demand and optimize station availability. The project also featured a user-friendly interface with real-time tracking and smooth interaction between users and the system.

challenges.problem: Predicting varying bike demand across stations
challenges.solution: Implemented regression models (Lasso and Ridge) for accurate demand forecasting
Designed responsive UI with Bootstrap and optimized backend queries

results: Improved availability by predicting demand trends
Reduced operational inefficiencies in bike distribution
Delivered a scalable and user-friendly bike-sharing solution
